The user wants flight cost estimate between first airport and second airport in the system's list (list_all_airports). They need economy class ticket price on date 2026-11-15.

We have to fetch list of airports via get_list_all_airports. Then pick first two entries' codes. Then call get_flight_cost with travel_from=code1, travel_to=code2, travel_date="2026-11-15", travel_class="economy". Provide result.

Thus we need to invoke get_all_airports. Let's do it.
